titleNative: アザミヤコを好きになる
synopsis: Sannomiya Makoto’s first day at a new school is filled with plenty of firsts, but he’s here for one thing: to meet Azami Yako, the daughter of a powerful CEO and his future fiancée! Knowing her only from a middle school photo, Makoto is eager to finally meet the girl he’s betrothed to—only to be extremely disappointed. Azami Yako is far from the ideal fiancée Makoto had imagined. She’s sloppy in appearance and manners, mumbles to herself constantly, and is all in all…cringe! Will getting to know her change Makoto’s first impression, or is he being set up to marry a suspicious weirdo? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis: Shuichi and Yuika have been close friends since they were kids.
